USES.definition: Answers: Does Entity A utilize Entity B as a tool, method, or resource to achieve a goal?

PRODUCES.definition: Answers: Is Entity B the result or output of Entity A?

ANALYZES.definition: Answers: Does Entity A study, examine, or measure Entity B?

INCLUDES.definition: Answers: Is Entity B a component, part, or member of Entity A?

IS_A.definition: Answers: Is Entity A an instance of, or a type of, Entity B?

COMPARES_TO.definition: Answers: Is a comparison being made between Entity A and Entity B?

INFLUENCES.definition: Answers: Does Entity A have a causal effect on Entity B?

SHOWS.definition: Answers: Does an Entity A show a behavior of the entity B?

IDENTIFIES.definition: Answers: Does an Entity A identify or discover B?

ADDRESSES.definition: Answers: Does Entity A (Model/Algorithm) aim to solve, tackle, or perform Entity B (Task)?

EVALUATED_ON.definition: Answers: Was Entity A (Model/Algorithm) benchmarked or tested using Entity B (Dataset)?

ACHIEVES.definition: Answers: Did Entity A (Model/Algorithm) reach a specific performance result on Entity B (Metric)?
